##### Project general facts

Samana Santorini is a one-of-a-kind holiday home development, with architecture that pays ode to one of the world's most magical destinations: Santorini, Greece. Its wild volcanic landscapes, rugged cliffs, magnificent beaches, and rich architecture are blended with a romantic mood to capture Santorini's soul in a lifestyle where love is the essence of life. Featuring studios, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom residences with private pools, a fully functional health club, and exotic water features, this project embodies the quintessence of being in Santorini while finding its roots in ancient Greek wisdom to create the most modern yet poetic architectural masterpiece.

The luxurious environment of Samana Santorini reflects a smart lifestyle with an extensive array of world-class amenities. Residents enjoy a health club, a green area, a swimming pool, a leisure pool deck, a kids' swimming pool, a kids' play area, iconic water features, a jacuzzi, a steam room, valet parking, and private swimming pools in select units. A barbeque area, outdoor cinema, pool cave, and balcony plunge pools further enhance the experience, creating a truly immersive Santorini-inspired lifestyle.

Every residence at Samana Santorini is adorned with everything one can desire for luxurious living in the mega-city of Dubai. The interiors reflect a smart lifestyle while finding their roots in ancient Greek wisdom, offering a modern yet poetic architectural masterpiece. The thoughtful design and high-quality finishes create spaces that are both stylish and functional, embodying the romantic mood and timeless beauty of Santorini.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in a strategic location between Sports City and Motor City, this exceptional location offers easy access to all facilities and recreational spots in Dubai. Despite having all amenities on site, the development's direct highway access allows residents to easily reach nearby attractions including Dubai International Stadium, schools, medical facilities, shopping centres, convenience stores, and a golf course in close proximity.

The location is distinguished by its proximity to major destinations. Tilal Al Ghaf, Gems Education, Dubai Autodrome, Dubai Miracle Garden, Dubai Butterfly Garden, Global Village, IMG Worlds of Adventure, Burj Al Arab, Mall of the Emirates, Dubai Hills Mall, Burj Khalifa, Palm Jumeirah, and Dubai Eye are all within easy reach, while both Dubai International Airport and Al Maktoum International Airport are conveniently accessible.

For those seeking a residence that embodies the romance of Santorini, modern convenience, and a prime Dubai address, this location delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of strategic connectivity, world-class amenities, and a prestigious location makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of city living — romantic, connected and effortlessly refined.
